title: Operator reconsiders the census hint window: provider pacing (seconds) or the source's freshness lifetime
goal: Retrospective of SP-etslk6yu: ST-f2n2h22c's gate g1 was answered by the orchestrator acting as operator with its recommendation, provider.pacing, so a census or refresh spares only a source a lookup checked seconds earlier, which in practice spares almost none. The operator decides whether the hint window stays provider.pacing or becomes the source's freshness lifetime (factdiff.lookup_hints takes provider.lifetime; the census still dates only what it confirms, D-tvjml75q); a test plants a cached result older than the pacing and younger than the lifetime and asserts the decided behaviour.
